title: Carroll's pyramid of corporate social responsibility
caption: Economic responsibility is the base on which everything else rests. Carroll argued that a socially responsible firm meets all four layers at the same time, not one after another.
alt: A pyramid of four layers. From the base: economic, legal, ethical, philanthropic.
description: Economic: be profitable, the base of the pyramid.
Ethical: do what is right and fair even where not required.
Philanthropic: be a good corporate citizen, for example through donations and community work.
arrowLabel: all four are met at the same time
